copy_rule: Chaperone abundance is treated as a carried adaptive stock across time points of the same culture.
cut_rule: reset_generation: subtract the inherited level so only contemporaneous fluctuation remains; stress demand and viability proxies stay in place.
notes: Closer to inscription/memory than to a true copy channel. Kept as an S-candidate only because README_BIO already maps S to chaperone density. A REJECT here is informative. Do not use the same genes for I (co-expression) and S.
